title: Clean Stock & Tissue-Culture Fundamentals
description: Develops specialist clean-stock reasoning from source identity and aseptic establishment through multiplication, rooting, acclimation, fidelity monitoring and evidence-based material release.
learningOutcomes: Distinguish identity, observed health, test status and release status when building a clean-stock record and material-status decision.
Design and execute a traceable aseptic workflow that separates clean and exposed states, detects breaches and preserves batch identity.
Interpret establishment and contamination patterns by source, explant, vessel, timing and process history, then select an evidence-preserving response.
Compare multiplication or regeneration treatments using genotype-aware quality measures rather than shoot count alone.
Evaluate in-vitro material through rooting, ex-vitro acclimation, fidelity monitoring and controlled release using stage-specific evidence.
